newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end 2.0 pct lower on trade data.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end 2.0 pct lower on trade data.

text.p: Foreign institutions led other players in dumping shares after Malaysia announced a 2.1 billion ringgit trade deficit when the market was already in a bearish mood, dealers and analysts said..

"It's reaction to the external trade balance figure. It's as bad as people expected, but people were hoping it wouldn't be true," said Pong Teng Swee, assistant research manager at brokers Seagroatt & Campbell.
At the close, the key Composite Index was down 22.03 points or 2.0 percent to 1,078.38.
